dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped annuli are distributed across the flank, characterized by irregular, high-contrast light perimeters with jagged outer edges transitioning from the dark base fur into a lighter interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of high-intensity light-pixel clusters localized along the upper dorsal region, where several blobs lack internal gradients and appear as solid, amorphous high-contrast patches.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent 'O' shaped annuli in the central flank form an irregular, elongated quadrilateral, while a triad of smaller high-intensity blobs towards the anterior forms an approximate isosceles triangle.
